C1053.title: Unauthorized Physical Access to Smartphones by Insiders
C1053.summary: This study examines the risk of unauthorized physical access to smartphones by insiders such as family members or close acquaintances. Attackers exploit physical contact with the device to bypass lock screens or leverage established trust relationships, directly obtaining sensitive data and posing a significant information security threat.

references.title: Know your enemy: the risk of unauthorized access in smartphones by insiders
